The '''Department of Redesign''' or '''Redesign Bureau'''<ref name="TC">{{JournalCite|6|The Cure}}</ref> was under the control of the [[Coalition for Improvements/Legends|Coalition for Improvements]]' [[Sector Development]] agencies. The Department was deployed to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that Improvements had deemed to be unsalvageable&mdash;worlds that would not, through any small modifications, be a loyal member of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. If the planet had value, the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] was called in, often with Redesign's assistance. Redesign's bland neutral description of its work&mdash;"state changes," "shock vectors," and "bifurcation manifolds"&mdash;hid some of the most heinous and evil acts ever undertaken by the Empire. Redesign rarely had the resources to focus their efforts on more than one planet in a given [[Sector/Legends|sector]] at any time.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
